recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It narrowly completes the published FHIR-I decision without changing the canonical value set URL, SubscriptionStatus resource, or SubscriptionStatus code system name.
issue_request: FHIR-35788 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution after reporting that SubscriptionStatus was declared both as the resource name and as the code type for SubscriptionStatus.status; FHIR-I resolved to rename the value set to SubscriptionStatusCodes in R4B and R5, with no code system rename.
initial_application: The Jira decision had been partially applied. Commit 8fa50a0dbc renamed the ValueSet name to SubscriptionStatusCodes, and commit 87c5c17847 restored the code system name to SubscriptionStatus while renaming the value set/source URL family and updating Subscription.status to bindingName SubscriptionStatusCodes. That same implementation only changed SubscriptionStatus.status to the new valueSet URL and left its bindingName as SubscriptionStatus.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists subscriptionstatus as an active resource in the fhir work group, so source/subscriptionstatus/structuredefinition-SubscriptionStatus.xml is in current build scope. Current source already has ValueSet/subscription-status named SubscriptionStatusCodes and CodeSystem/subscription-status named SubscriptionStatus, matching the Jira note not to rename the code system. Confluence FHIR-I minutes from 2022-01-24 independently record the 15-0-0 motion to rename the value set to SubscriptionStatusCodes; targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscriptionstatus/structuredefinition-SubscriptionStatus.xml so SubscriptionStatus.status's elementdefinition-bindingName is SubscriptionStatusCodes instead of SubscriptionStatus. This completes the rename at the active resource element that still exposed the old code-generation name.
source_changes: source/subscriptionstatus/structuredefinition-SubscriptionStatus.xml: changed SubscriptionStatus.status elementdefinition-bindingName from SubscriptionStatus to SubscriptionStatusCodes.
